svg.text: VSEISMO carrier board, PCB placement rev A (top view, grid 5 mm, not for fabrication)
Placement and zoning only: no routing. Import seismo-carrier.net into KiCad, then route and run DRC.
Board 130 x 90 mm, 2 layers, 1.6 mm FR-4, 1 oz copper
power: star GND at P1, U1 far from analog
D2 cathode to J1-14 (5V) by a 1 mm
Bottom: solid GND pour, stitched to
top GND fill, vias every ~10 mm.
AMP_GND: per channel, from P2-2 / P3-2
to P4-2 / P5-1, GND only at R30.
No GND pour under R20-R23, C10-C11.
U1 loop small, far from the analog zone,
SPI and DRDY: short, over solid GND,
CLKIN: Y1 close to JP1 and P6.
Terminal wire entry faces the edge.
